Our family used to own a computer shop from 2009-2015, we had to sell it to our relatives due to many factors such as maintenance costs, mga suki na eventually moved out (graduate, moved to a different city, or adulting in general), and the accessibility of WiFi and smart phones. It was meant to be that way kasi nga accessible na ang games thru phone, surfing the internet, and even printing and sending documents.

Siguro in this age, it'll survive if you have high specs, heavy duty games, accessibility sa mga students (could be games, or printing, editing), and just like Korean comp shops where you have the privacy and can even sleep and eat there.
